newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Comfort names Goh Chee Wee managing dir.
newsitem.headline: Comfort names Goh Chee Wee managing dir.

text.p: Goh Chee Wee, a former minister of state for trade and industry and for communications, was appointed group managing director of listed transport firm Comfort Group Ltd, the company said in a statement on Monday.
Goh's appointment followed the January 3 resignation of Sam Chong Keen as managing director.
Goh was also former deputy secretary general of the National Trade Union Congress (NTUC).
The NTUC is the former owner of Comfort Group, which was listed on the Stock Exchange of Singapore in 1994.
